pr_comments:
> Cool!
> See the following suggested changes:
> 
> * `_rollingTime` isn't used?
> * `_rollingData` only needs to hold the last 3 values? don't think it's related to `period`
> * `period` should just be the period of the STD? not use `period - 2`
> * `RollingWindow` allows index `[]` access
> 
> > Test data from TradingView
> 
> ✅ nice
> 
> ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18473240/124671572-10963800-de8c-11eb-8877-498482cc4ec9.png)

Thank you for the review. I see what you are saying to not use period-2 but it needs to be used. Ie. If we have a period of 22, we need the additional 2 bars of data to get the previousPoints, then the SD is of period 20. Just made a push, let me know what you think.
Nice. Eager to see this approved and merged!
@Martin-Molinero i see now. I'll add that test case and remove period-2. I will also make WarmUpPeriod = period + 2.
Thanks for the quick turn around on this, @Martin-Molinero !
